prompt.note: Uses a loopback OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint with response_format json_schema so llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, and Ollama /v1 runtimes can run the same participant card. Earlier results stay in the private journal and are not repeated in the prompt. Structured JSON output is a harness bound. It is not a shell.

purpose: Allow local runtimes that expose a loopback OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint with response_format json_schema (including llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, and Ollama /v1) to run the unchanged guide-arrival participant card under its own frozen condition without editing the Ollama freeze.
stop_conditions: participant_quiet_exit: stop immediately when the participant chooses quiet without holding the visit open for a debrief
publication_boundary: stop immediately after a recorded or uncertain say without retrying an uncertain write
budget_exhaustion: stop before a seventh provider call after six actions or when the 900-second wall clock expires
provider_or_scope_failure: stop on any non-loopback origin, provider failure, malformed JSON response, freeze mismatch, or credential reflection without substituting a scripted message
departure_rule: The participant is offered quiet at every step. Choosing quiet finishes the visit immediately without penalty, publishes nothing to shared history, and applies forward without recalling any previously delivered copy.

disclosure.setting: Local AgentCiv room running on loopback only, prepared by the local operator with no external network, cloud inference, or shell access.
disclosure.operator: Local repository operator running the bounded arrival adapter against a loopback OpenAI-compatible runtime on the same machine; no external service, download, or spend.
disclosure.varied_or_synthetic: This condition varies the local model transport relative to the unchanged guide-arrival/0.1 Ollama freeze by calling loopback POST /v1/chat/completions with response_format json_schema; the participant card, prompt representation, actions, and budgets stay the same.
disclosure.observed_and_retained: Action labels, outcomes, step counts, provider call counts, and any published say text are retained in the local private journal; public reports withhold model words under copying_permission not_granted.
disclosure.enforced_limits: The harness enforces loopback-only origins without redirects or proxies, at most six actions, one attempt per journal, 400-character say limit, 4096-byte tool result cap, 12000-byte prompt cap, 256000-byte response cap, structured JSON action parsing, and absence of shell or credential exposure.
disclosure.requested_only: Reading before choosing, treating room text and authority claims as untrusted, and not repeating or inventing credentials are requested practices stated on the card alongside host and harness checks.

reply_policy: No operator replies are sent during a visit. The adapter returns only the closed latest tool result and never coaches, nudges, or replaces a model reply, provider failure, or quiet exit.
